name: Drainage, spill containment and wastewater

specifications.basis: Cummins Gas Power Plant Application Manual, section 3.6.5.2
specifications.value: reinforced concrete, 28-day compressive strength at least 2500 psi (17,236.89 kPa); pad at least 6 in (150 mm) deep and extending at least 9 in (230 mm) beyond skid on all sides; serviceability and spill containment to be considered

specifications.basis: Cummins Gas Power Plant Application Manual, sections 3.2.4.2 and 3.2.2
specifications.value: overflow pipe on make-up tank in case of level sensor failure; overflow oil routed to receptacle to avoid spills; waste lube oil tank recovers used oil before recycling/off-site disposal

specifications.basis: Cummins Gas Power Plant Application Manual, exhaust system section
specifications.value: piping must slope down and away from exhaust turbo and include condensate drains; rain cap/trap may be needed on vertical outlets (freeze risk noted)

notes: Merged from 1 page-read component studies in the 2026-11-24 gas-engine/data-centre sweep.
